identity.location: Rio Lakefront, 9811 Washingtonian Blvd L9, Gaithersburg, MD 20878

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies Charley Chesapeake Chophouse at Rio Lakefront in Gaithersburg and links all menu surfaces and ordering.
Current main menu enumerates oysters, appetizers, crab cakes, entrees, burgers, sandwiches and entree salads with ingredient descriptions and a downloadable PDF.
Current weekday lunch Pick Two menu enumerates half salads, sandwiches, petite mains and half pastas.
Current weekend brunch page enumerates brunch entrees plus the main food catalog and sides with explicit ingredient descriptions.
Restaurant-issued vegetarian and vegan menu enumerates appetizers, vegan crab items, vegetarian entrees and sides.
Current dessert and coffee menu enumerates desserts and nonalcoholic espresso, cappuccino, latte, drip coffee and tea; alcohol-only drinks excluded.
Beverage page was inspected; alcohol-only cocktails, beer and wine are outside POC scope.
Happy-hour page enumerates fry baskets, smashburger, shrimp cocktail, wings, oysters, hummus and five-spice pork; alcohol-only offers excluded.
Restaurant-linked Toast confirms the same Gaithersburg address and exposes dinner plus family meals; no allergen matrix found.

Inspected linked main, lunch, brunch, vegetarian and dessert PDFs plus sitemap/download surfaces; ingredient descriptions were present but no separate allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found.
Targeted domain search surfaced official menu pages and PDFs but no official allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient guide or allergy policy.
